summary: Iter116 frontend-only retest of the KtpPrintToast early-ack buffer fix (iter115 race). Mobile 390x844, Anita PIN 4321, fake KT-V520 printers that ack instantly. (1) 1 printer x5 kasgeld saves: green 'Bon geprint op TEST KTP iter116 A' 5/5. 0 'Geen antwoord' after a 22s wait. The kasgeld-print-ktp button shows the done check. 1 of the 5 acks arrived before the HTTP response; it was buffered and re-dispatched correctly. (2) 2 printers x5: merged toast 'A en B' 5/5 (once 'B en A', cosmetic). 0 false red toasts. (3) DETERMINISTIC race: page.route delays the remote-print HTTP response by 1.2s, so every ack lands before trackKtpJob. 2 printers x3: merged toast 3/3. All 6 jobs show 2 done events (buffered, then re-dispatched). 0 'Geen antwoord' after 22s. (4) Second device (separate browser context, same kiosk): it received all 6 REMOTE_PRINT_DONE events but showed 0 toasts. (5) ok:false ack ('Geen papier'): red toast 'Printen mislukt op TEST KTP iter116 A — Geen papier'. (6) History modal PrintChoiceMenu (HUIS 2C) under the forced race: history-print-status shows 'Geprint op TEST KTP iter116 A' (emerald), the green toast appears, and nothing turns to a timeout after 25s. (7) KtpPrintButton in the KioskPrintsOverlay was NOT runtime-verified. The overlay lists 3 'Anita Sewdas' cards, but none has a print-log row with a KT-V520 button (likely stale employee IDs from the demo reset). I stopped after 3 attempts. Its code path matches PrintChoiceMenu: job.current is set before trackKtpJob, and the re-dispatch runs in setTimeout 0, after the local timer has started.

ui_bugs.issue: The button switches to the 'done' check as soon as the POST succeeds, not when the printer acks. With an ok:false ack ('Geen papier') the button still shows a green-check 'done' while the red toast says the print failed. Pre-existing, minor.

issues: Shows 3 identical 'Anita Sewdas' cards (one per old employee id after demo resets). Hard to tell apart, and the cards open empty lists. Cosmetic/data issue.

action_items: LOW (optional): in KasgeldReceipt useKasgeldPrint, drive the 'ktp' status from the REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ack (ok/error) instead of the POST result.

LOW (optional): 2 printers that both fail produce 2 separate red toasts, and the second replaces the first, so only one printer's error is visible. Consider merging error toasts the way ok toasts are merged.
critical_code_review_comments: The buffer fix is correct. Unmatched acks are stored in the 'early' map for 30s. trackKtpJob consumes the buffer and re-dispatches the ack in setTimeout(0), so component listeners (KtpPrintButton/PrintChoiceMenu) also handle it, because they set job.current before calling trackKtpJob. No 20s timer is started for buffered jobs.

Minor: the setTimeout(() => early.delete(id), 30000) in the listener is never cancelled. Harmless, because a consumed entry is already deleted. The buffer also collects every other device's acks for 30s (small memory, fine).
Second-device isolation holds: acks for job_ids that this device never tracked are buffered, then expire without a toast.
